zh_CN.TIP_LAYER: 先点开压在上面的气泡
zh_CN.TIP_CHAIN: 锁链泡：每装满一缸减 1，到 0 解开
zh_CN.TIP_TIMER: 限时缸：时间到之前装满它
zh_CN.TIP_FOG: 迷雾泡：点破别的气泡，雾就散开
zh_CN.TIP_ICE: 冰冻泡：点破连着的气泡就解冻
zh_CN.TIP_PAIR: 结伴鱼：点一条，两条一起走
zh_CN.H_LEAVE_LINE: 现在退出会扣 1 条命
zh_CN.TIP_LIVES: 从这关起，中途退出会扣 1 条命
zh_CN.TIP_CLOCK: 从这关起挑战关限时：时间用完前救出所有小鱼，连击能加时间
zh_CN.TIP_QUEUE: 排队泡：里面的鱼排着队，只能取最前面最亮的那条
zh_CN.TIP_TOOLS3: 从这里起关卡更难了，每种道具每关能用 3 次
zh_CN.TIP_BUFFER4: 从这里起暂存槽只有 4 格，放错更容易满，卡住就用道具
zh_CN.RESCUE_LINE: 用吹泡清空槽位，接着玩
zh_CN.SLOT_LINE: 多一个鱼缸，装满一缸就收走
zh_CN.SEA_NEW_LINE: 这里有 %d 种新的小鱼
zh_CN.BOOT_TIP_1: 排队泡里只有最前面那条能点
zh_CN.BOOT_TIP_4: 暂存槽快满时用吹泡清空
zh_CN.BOOT_TIP_5: 渔网能把一缸直接装满
zh_CN.BOOT_TIP_8: 收集卡片能集齐整本收藏册
zh_CN.BOOT_HEALTH:
抵制不良游戏，拒绝盗版游戏。注意自我保护，谨防受骗上当。
适度游戏益脑，沉迷游戏伤身。合理安排时间，享受健康生活。

en.UI_NET_HINT: Tap a tank to fill it
en.TIP_CHAIN: Chains: each full tank counts down
en.TIP_TIMER: Timer tank: fill it before time's up
en.TIP_FOG: Fog: pop other bubbles to clear it
en.TIP_ICE: Ice: pop the linked bubble to thaw it
en.TIP_LIVES: From now on, quitting costs a life
en.TIP_CLOCK: Challenge levels are timed now: rescue every fish before time runs out. Combos add time
en.TIP_QUEUE: Queue bubble: fish line up. Only the bright one in front can go
en.TIP_TOOLS3: Levels get harder from here. Each booster can be used 3 times per level
en.TIP_BUFFER4: Only 4 holding slots from here on. They fill up fast — use boosters when stuck
en.RESCUE_LINE: Use Blow to clear the slots and keep going
en.SLOT_LINE: One extra tank. It leaves when full
en.DAILY_RETRY_HINT: Retry with an ad or coins
en.BOOT_TIP_1: Only the front fish in a queue bubble can be taken
en.BOOT_TIP_2: Three of a kind fill a tank
en.BOOT_TIP_5: The Net fills a whole tank
en.BOOT_TIP_8: Collect cards to finish an album
